verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Composio serves an llms.txt at docs.composio.dev/llms.txt. Its docs pages are also available as .md files, and it ships agent-oriented setup docs plus an Agent Skill that helps coding agents follow the current integration path. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively, and no evidence of an expanded full-content llms file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.composio.dev/llms.txt # Composio Documentation
Install the Composio Agent Skill so your coding agent can understand your project and follow the current Platform integration path.
